warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3-4 at 3.00 + 2.50 + 3.00 (8.50); y = A-B at 4.00. Origin A1 (row A is drawn at the top of every plan). The main chains print on S-01 (all three views), S-02, A-03, A-04, A-05, A-06, A-07 and all agree. Vector CAD PDF; dimension figures are vector strokes (no text layer) and were read off zoomed renders of the page.

Section 4 rule 4 (every printed x/y tick is a line): structural ticks 2' (4.20) and 2'' (4.30) from S-01, A'''' (1.25) and A'''''' (2.75) from S-01; roof ticks 1'/4' and A'/B' (1.00 eaves, A-03 roof plan + S-02), the ridge A''''' (2.00, S-02 + A-03 roof plan); truss T1 panel points A'' (1.00) and A'''''''' (3.00) from the TRUSS T1 chain 1.00 x 4; A''' (1.15) and A''''''' (2.85) from the A-03 floor-plan chain 1.15 | 1.70 | 1.15 (architectural, nothing structural sits on them).

2' (4.20) and 2'' (4.30) are two different points 0.10 apart, both printed: the +0.00 plan prints 1.20 + 1.30 above row A and 1.30 + 1.20 under row B, and the main plan's B1 beams are drawn on 1.20 (upper) and 1.30 (lower) respectively (measured on the render: 1.20 / 1.31). Kept as two lines.

A''' (1.15) vs A'''' (1.25) and A'''''' (2.75) vs A''''''' (2.85) are 0.10 apart: the floor plan's 1.15 | 1.70 | 1.15 and the structure plans' 1.25 | 1.50 | 1.25 are different printed chains (wall/window lines vs beam lines), so all four are kept.
TRUSS T1 (S-02) is drawn with B on the left and A on the right; its 1.00 x 4 chain is symmetric so drawing direction does not change any position. TRUSS T2 prints grid bubbles 1-4.

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนน (A-04..A-07, A-01 notes). Every elevation/section prints the same z chain 1.30 | 3.40 | 1.42 = 6.12. Room-tag levels +0.10 (stair landings) and +1.20 (ระเบียง) have no printed label — id null. ระดับดินเดิม (S-03 F1/F2) and ระดับดิน (S-03 ST-1) are printed without a value — level_m null.

Dimension sweep covers S-01, S-02, A-03 (floor plan + roof plan), A-04/A-05 (elevations) and A-06/A-07 (sections). S-03/S-04 print only member-internal dimensions (pile-cap plan sizes and pile spacing, cap depth, 1.00 to ระดับดินเดิม, section sizes, slab thickness, stair riser/tread, truss depths 1.57/0.87 and 1.44/0.70), which stay on their elements. A-08 door/window dimensions stay on the schedule elements. E-01 was not swept (op04 skips electrical).
The rafter lines on the S-02 plan (จันทัน @1.00 m.) are not dimensioned individually; no dummy lines were made for them (recorded as one counted element in the roof-framing file).

dummy_grid_rule_check.negative_pos_m: x: 1' = -1.00 (eave left of grid 1). y: A' = -1.00 (eave beyond row A), first in A's prime sequence.
